newsitem.title: USA: Hudson Hotels sees '97 revs topping $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hudson Hotels sees '97 revs topping $40 mln.

text.p: Hudson Hotels Corp said on Monday that it expects 1997 revenues to exceed $40 million, topping the $14.1 million reported for 1996.
In 1996, Hudson Hotels completed acquisitions of 17 properties, including 12 on November 27.
Hudson Hotels said it manages 31 hotel properties, including 17 that it owns.
"This year we will benefit from an entire year of operations of the 17 acquisitions, as compared to less than five months of 1996," the company said in a statement.
